skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Direct DMG 60% ATK to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Direct DMG 60% ATK to all enemies. Applies [Armed Collapse] to 3 random enemies.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Direct DMG 60% > 70% ATK to all enemies. Applies [Armed Collapse] to 3 random enemies > all enemies.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases HP by (+20). While Round < 3, after taking an action, removes [Energy] from the target enemy (up to once per round; cannot inflict [Fear] on that enemy in the same round after a successful removal). At battle start, permanently gains +30% [Instant DMG Evasion].[Instant DMG Evasion]: Direct DMG, Ex. DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG each deal only 1 DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Whenever Bang attacks, summons Bomb to [Combo Attack] with a similar attack: Basic — deals 100% ATK to a random enemy; Ultimate — 3-hit AoE for 180% ATK. [Combo Attack] uses Bang's ATK as its DMG (Bomb does not need to be on your team).

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: [Combo Attack] Ultimate ATK 180% > 210%. For each enemy with [Internal Injury], reduces that enemy's [Energy Gauge] by 250.

effects.desc: Debuff applies to all enemies when their Energy is reduced, blocking or destroying their Energy, making them unable to use their ultimate.
Mark a unit, unlocking a raid condition or bonus effect associated with the mark.
Floors that each cause a direct, additional, charge, or berserk attack to only deal 1 damage.
Unfavorable effects cause delayed damage, storing additional damage (600-800% of Gouketsu's ST), releasing when the target is hit or when [Detonate].
Removes existing effects/buffs on all enemies.
